semantic_notes: The difference recurrence is n*A(n)=(n+1)*A(n-1)+8*n-5 for n>0. Uniqueness against closedForm requires A(0)=1 and the complete positive-n recurrence; these assumptions are not omitted.

Nonnegativity holds at all natural n. The explicit logarithmic bounds preserve n>=1 for16*n*(1+log n), and n>=2 for16*(1+1/log2)*n*log n and32*n*logb2(n). Big-O statements use Nat atTop and real norms.
The numerical examples retain values1,5,13,71/3. Both n=0 and n=1 explicitly fail any pure C*n*logb2(n) bound; this does not conflict with the eventual Big-O results.
occurrenceRank is an actual permutation of Fin(input.length), with arbitrary payload and LinearOrder keys. Rank comparison equivalence requires Nodup of mapped keys, not merely distinct payloads.
The left-child length equals the selected occurrence rank after eraseIdx of precisely that occurrence and filtering by keys below its key. No payload equality or inhabitant is introduced.
The right child is the complementary Boolean filter of the same eraseIdx remainder and has natural length n-1-rank. Both child key lists retain Nodup under the original mapped-key Nodup premise.

The actual PMF.map law sends uniform occurrence choice to uniform left-child size through Fin.val. It retains a nonempty head::tail input and its actual key/filter/erase-index expressions; it is not an assumed size distribution.

Equal input lengths imply equal exercise means across arbitrary payload types and distinct LinearOrder key types, provided each mapped-key list is Nodup. The sizeMean bridge therefore preserves the exact distinct-key domain.

sizeMean has zero value1 and the actual successor mean recurrence with average2/(m+1), all Fin(m+1) subproblem sizes and toll4*m+3. The range-form recurrence requires positive n and uses real division.
Empty-rank identity, uninhabited empty expectation, singleton rank0, and actual sizeMean values5,13,71/3 are all retained in the compiled public types.
